description: SPARQL fixtures for the Happn banking RDF converted from the Apache OSSIE package + demo CSVs.

queries.description: Customers reaching a suspicious account via related-party + beneficial ownership (≤3 hops).
OpenSuspiciousActivity extends SuspiciousActivity (TBox from OSSIE extends).
NPL loans typed as NonPerformingLoan (ABox typing from OSSIE extends + abox_binding type_when).
queries.sparql:
PREFIX happn: <https://example.com/happn-bank#>
SELECT (COUNT(*) AS ?c) WHERE { ?x a happn:NonPerformingLoan }
